description: This Java source file defines the ResizeOperation class, which implements the EditOperation interface to handle resize interactions within an Android UI designer tool. It manages resize logic, feedback display, and resize points for UI components.

classes.name: ResizeOperation
classes.description: Handles resize interactions for UI components in Android Studio's layout editor, including feedback rendering and resize logic.

methods.name: getResizedBounds
methods.description: Calculates the new bounds of the component based on mouse movement and resize direction, preserving aspect ratio if needed.

methods.name: setComponents
methods.description: Sets multiple components for resize operation (empty implementation).

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Initializes the resize operation with a specific component.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes resize context and feedback visuals based on the component and resize direction.

methods.name: createResizeContext
methods.description: Creates a new ResizeContext object to track resize state.

methods.name: setNewSizeBounds
methods.description: Applies the new size bounds to the component, updating layout attributes.

methods.name: getResizeUpdateMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-facing message indicating the current resize operation.

methods.name: onResizeBegin
methods.description: Hook for actions when resize starts.

methods.name: onResizeUpdate
methods.description: Updates resize bounds and visual feedback during resize.

methods.name: updateResizeMessage
methods.description: Updates the feedback message shown during resize.

methods.name: canExecute
methods.description: Indicates whether the resize operation can be executed (always true).

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the resize operation within a write action.

methods.name: addResizePoints
methods.description: Adds resize handles to the selection decorator based on resize policy.
